fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' launches a bomb at the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels and explodes upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
fields.description2: The bomb also grants {{tip|sight}} of the impact area for 6 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for the same duration.
fields.notes:
* The missile has a minimum travel time of {{fd|0.227}} seconds.
}}
